mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and it is not disabled anywhere.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states that TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included, and is not disabled anywhere.

The basis is thin. It comes from a session record (#21, "verification on all builds") that Muninn holds at trust 1, meaning it was seen in a transcript but not confirmed by a commit or exit code. It is newer than an earlier record (#20) that said verification was disabled in dev builds, so I treated #20 as retired and left it out of the file. Muninn's own `why` check called the evidence insufficient, because nothing at trust 2 or higher covers this topic. If you want a firmer basis, confirm the policy explicitly and it can be recorded as a proper decision.
